content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Fouling of ultrafiltration membranes in protein-rich bioprocess streams is driven by protein conformation, aggregation state, and particle packing density, with these mechanisms characterized through resistance-in-series diagnostic frameworks and surface analysis.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03384","field":"abstract","quote":"protein conformation and aggregation state in foulant deposit formation; the resistance-in-series framework"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-03376","field":"abstract","quote":"cake filtration and intermediate blocking models were fitted to experimental flux–volume data"}]},{"text":"Enzymatic pre-treatment of fermentation broths with protease prior to ultrafiltration can reduce fouling resistance and increase limiting flux by breaking down residual cell debris and proteins that form cake layers on membranes.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03380","field":"abstract","quote":"Pre-treatment of a model fermentation broth with a commercial serine protease was evaluated as a fouling mitigation strategy"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-03380","field":"abstract","quote":"At a hydrolysis degree of 16%, the limiting flux increased by 38% compared with untreated broth"}]},{"text":"Cleaning-in-place protocol effectiveness and membrane lifetime are assessed through measurement of irreversible fouling resistance accumulation and the impact of alkaline and oxidative CIP chemistries on membrane material integrity.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03384","field":"abstract","quote":"alkaline and oxidative CIP chemistries and their impact on membrane material integrity over extended operational lifetimes"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher's publications directly address ultrafiltration fouling mechanisms in bioprocess streams [SYN-PUB-03384, SYN-PUB-03376], characterize how residual biomass and cell debris form cake layers that decline flux [SYN-PUB-03380], and evaluate enzymatic pre-treatment as a pre-filtration mitigation strategy to reduce fouling [SYN-PUB-03380], which matches the core challenge of improving depth-filter performance to prevent residual cells from fouling 10 kDa polyethersulfone membranes."}
